title: GASS: Geometry-Aware Spherical Sampling for Disentangled Diversity Enhancement in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the lack of intrinsic sample diversity (visual homogenization) in generated image batches using reference-free metrics like Vendi Score (VS) and the proposed geometric Spherical Spread Score (SPP), as well as reference-based metrics like Density and Coverage on standard benchmarks (ImageNet and DrawBench).
